El sistema utilizaba inteligencia artificial para detectar en tiempo real aumentos de volumen y expresiones de riesgo, silenciar temporalmente la transmisión y reproducir mensajes personalizados para evitar interrupciones o sanciones.
summary.en: Frontend development for AntiBan-Ad, a working Sprite tool for streamers. Implementation of the campaign and registration landing page, as well as the interface and overlay integrated into the plugin experience. The system used artificial intelligence to detect volume spikes and risky expressions in real time, temporarily mute the stream, and play personalized messages to prevent interruptions or penalties.

title.en: Newsan Creator — Internal AI Image Generation Platform

summary.en: Frontend development for Newsan Creator, an internal platform for generating and refining product and campaign images using artificial intelligence. Implementation of authentication, navigation, product and campaign management, history, reference selection, output formats, image downloads, loading states, and responsive behavior. Frontend integration with the authenticated backend and AI workflows, using polling and Socket.IO to communicate generation progress for Flux Kontext and Flux Dev.
